name: lua_momentum
author: BlitzkriegBot
description: Official Lua example (E30/issue 336), both legs re-armed (operator ruling 2026-11-04, undoing #849's down-only gate) with a dust floor and configurable exits. Momentum premise: a leg whose own mid moves >= threshold (default 4%) in one tick arms its direction — a crashing leg buys the DOWN token, a rising leg buys the UP token; a sub-threshold move disarms, an opposite move flips the premise and cancels the resting bid. Entries rest pure maker (issue 742's entry_maker declaration) at the leg's own best_bid under the never-escalate clock. min_entry_price (default 0.15, the operator's 筹码地板) refuses any entry whose best_bid is below it — the near-zero lottery leg (0.007 tickets bought because they were the best_bid) has nothing left to catch; 0 disables the floor. Exits are strategy signals judged on the fresh best bid after a taker fee (official 0.07*p*(1-p); a zero PolySim schedule does not zero the model): take_profit_pct (default 40), optional take_profit_price, a trailing stop that arms after trail_arm_pct (default 20) and sells on trail_giveback_pct percentage points of giveback (default 15), and an optional exit_time_left_sec deadline (default 0 = off). A position that hits none of them still holds to settlement. Time-weighted tightening (2026-11-06 operator rule, v0.4.0): take_profit_pct_tight / trail_arm_pct_tight / trail_giveback_pct_tight (each default 0 = the flat band unchanged) slide their base band LINEARLY from base at round start to the tight value as the round clock drains — binary pricing converges to {0,1} like the time-weighted coin it is, so a band sized for 900s is mispriced late. The elapsed fraction is the round's own (duration − time_left)/duration; bands never dip below the tight value, and a tight >= base stays flat (a wrong config cannot loosen). Thesis death NOT declared (operator ruling 2026-11-08): the #961 hook measured live as a misfire on a momentum scalper — the premise flip fires on ordinary book chop and the reversal band is one tick on 0.15-0.50 binary tokens, so positions died 0-24s after entry (measured ~20% WR window vs the 72% cumulative baseline). This package declares NO thesis death; its own exits (take-profit band, trailing stop, stop_loss_pct=50, hold to settlement) are the risk managers. Declaration is opt-in; the exemption reason lives in scripts/thesis-death-check.mjs. allow_both_sides defaults to 0: the opposite token of the same condition is not bought, even though holds_to_settlement would waive the kernel's one-per-asset gate. max_entries_per_round defaults to 1: after an exit in a condition, that round gets no new entry (the unfilled maker bid may still be re-quoted). reentry_cooldown_sec defaults to 0.
stop_loss_ruling: operator ruling 2026-11-06: sanctioned protective stop via stop_loss_pct knob
